pillar: 5 — Organic social (also serves 11 — PR and comms: crisis replies)
intents: What are people saying about me and my category this week?
Who's talking about us / any mentions this week?
Is a complaint blowing up? Something's brewing on TikTok / Reddit
What's trending in my category, and should we jump on it?
What posts are going viral in my niche?
reads: brand brain: summary, kit, products, accounts, competitors, organic posts (with sync date), learnings (brand_read) — learn-my-brand / server research
public web: news, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and LinkedIn public posts and comments — host web search and browser (free pass, samples)
claims and voice through the claims-gate atom (learn-my-brand's contract) — learn-my-brand
operating rules: crisis escalation, refund policy, disclosure rules (knowledge_search) — learn-my-brand (asks when absent)
competitor roster with socials (competitor_read) — research-competitors / research-market
own managed accounts and metrics (social_account_list, social_analytics_get) — the product
research runs' discovered posts and saved inspiration (social_inspiration_search, social_inspiration_library) — the product / listen-social
for the S1 hold list: live paid ads (meta_read), workspace social/calendar/* — run-organic-social, lifecycle/* — email-lifecycle
watchlist, baseline report and items: workspace social/listening/* — listen-social itself
shared price history: workspace research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md — every playbook that spends on data
writes: weekly listening report (full or short form, opening 'Do this first, because…'): workspace social/listening/<D>-report.md (D = counting week's Monday) + brand document (keep-history) — read by the human, analyze-performance (header lines), run-organic-social (trend table), research-market (VoC-tagged quotes)
watchlist (versioned query set): workspace social/listening/watchlist.md + document (supersede) — read by listen-social each week
items file: workspace social/listening/<D>-items.jsonl (workspace only) — read by the next run and same-week re-runs
reply-draft queue: workspace social/listening/<D>-replies.md (workspace only) — read by the human, who sends

saved outliers and competitor winners: inspiration library via social_inspiration_save (tag listen-social) — read by make-static-ads, make-video-ads, make-content, work-with-creators, run-organic-social
up to 3 [listening …] learnings (rules, one idea each) through the save-learning atom, only on the human's yes — read by ad and content generation
method files for the coworker: workspace social/listening/method/* — read by the standing run
weekly listening schedule (opt-in, created paused): automation_upsert agent job
credits log rows: workspace research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md — read by the next pull of any playbook
